title: Hidden cubes
experimentalTitle: Experimental: built from nearby game traffic and may stop working after a game update.
description: Possible cube locations from the game's own map data, and cubes the game has sent near you while capture runs, marked where they were received. A possible location is not a sighting, and there is no map-wide scan or respawn timer.
limitation: Nearby observations only. Detection range is not exact, and a first sighting is not when the cube spawned.

capture.preview: Open the desktop app to see nearby cubes.

position.unknown: No position of your character yet
position.hint: Distance and direction return when a fresh position of your character is received.

statusTitle.observed: Received nearby and not opened as far as capture saw.
statusTitle.out_of_view: Out of your view range. It may still be there; it was not seen being opened.

distanceUnknownTitle: Distance and direction need a fresh position of your character.
bearingTitle: {{degrees}}° from north on the map, independent of your camera.
totals: This session: {{observed, number}} sightings received · {{opened, number}} openings observed (anyone's)

stats.label: This session
stats.openingsHint: Openings by anyone that capture saw

empty.title: No cubes observed yet
empty.note: A cube appears here when the game sends one near you. Explore to receive more.

map.unknownShort: This area isn't on these maps

layers.label: Layers

possible.source: From the game's own map data. Only some of these places hold a cube at any time, so a pin is a place to check, not a sighting.
possible.note: A cube may or may not be here now.
possible.distanceTitle: Straight-line distance on the map from your current position, ignoring height

clearTitle: Forget the cubes tracked so far. Cubes in range are received again as the game sends them.
